msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia perfumeria-petalos-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury beauty campaign still life of rows of dark boxed perfumes on a shelf under a golden arch from the reference. The product stands in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm cinematic light, rich textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia perfumeria-petalos-02c.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a silver and white perfume box with an abstract teardrop design from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia perfumeria-petalos-19c.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a white perfume box with blue butterflies and a gold star emblem from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail.
